description: TYPE/DOMAIN/AGGREGATE/OPERATOR/FUNCTION/PROCEDURE acceptance on postgresql17 (#124): composite/enum/range/base types, domains, aggregates, operators, functions and procedures lifecycle execute natively.

ddl_steps.name: create schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t41

ddl_steps.name: create enum type
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TYPE t41.mood AS ENUM ('sad','ok','happy')

ddl_steps.name: alter type add value
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TYPE t41.mood ADD VALUE 'ecstatic'

ddl_steps.name: create composite type
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TYPE t41.addr AS (street text, city text)

ddl_steps.name: create range type
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TYPE t41.intrange AS RANGE (subtype = int4)

ddl_steps.name: alter type rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TYPE t41.addr RENAME TO addr2

ddl_steps.name: alter type owner
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE ROLE t41_owner LOGIN; ALTER TYPE t41.addr2 OWNER TO t41_owner

ddl_steps.name: create domain
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE DOMAIN t41.email AS text CHECK (VALUE ~ '.+@.+') NOT NULL

ddl_steps.name: alter domain add constraint
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DOMAIN t41.email ADD CONSTRAINT email_len CHECK (length(VALUE) > 3)

ddl_steps.name: alter domain rename constraint
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DOMAIN t41.email RENAME CONSTRAINT email_len TO email_minlen

ddl_steps.name: alter domain set default
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DOMAIN t41.email SET DEFAULT 'x@y'

ddl_steps.name: use domain in table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t41.members (id int, email t41.email)

ddl_steps.name: create function
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION t41.addone(int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS 'SELECT $1 + 1'

ddl_steps.name: create function plpgsql
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION t41.addtwo(int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN $1 + 2; END; $$

ddl_steps.name: alter function rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FUNCTION t41.addone(int) RENAME TO plusone

ddl_steps.name: alter function set schema
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FUNCTION t41.plusone(int) SET SCHEMA public

ddl_steps.name: create procedure
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE PROCEDURE t41.bump(x int) LANGUAGE sql AS 'SELECT x + 1'

ddl_steps.name: alter procedure rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER PROCEDURE t41.bump(int) RENAME TO bump2

ddl_steps.name: alter routine rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER ROUTINE public.plusone(int) RENAME TO plusone2

ddl_steps.name: create aggregate
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE AGGREGATE t41.mysum(int) (SFUNC = int4pl, STYPE = int)

ddl_steps.name: alter aggregate rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER AGGREGATE t41.mysum(int) RENAME TO mysum2

ddl_steps.name: create operator
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE OPERATOR t41.=== (LEFTARG = int, RIGHTARG = int, FUNCTION = int4eq)

ddl_steps.name: alter operator restrict/join
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER OPERATOR t41.=== (int, int) SET (RESTRICT = eqsel, JOIN = eqjoinsel)

ddl_steps.name: drop function/procedure/aggregate/operator
ddl_steps.sql: DROP FUNCTION public.plusone2(int); DROP PROCEDURE t41.bump2(int); DROP AGGREGATE t41.mysum2(int); DROP OPERATOR t41.=== (int, int)

ddl_steps.name: drop types/domains
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TABLE t41.members; DROP DOMAIN t41.email; DROP TYPE t41.mood, t41.addr2, t41.intrange

ddl_steps.name: drop routine
ddl_steps.sql: DROP ROUTINE IF EXISTS t41.addtwo

ddl_steps.name: drop schema
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t41 CASCADE; DROP ROLE t41_owner

post_state_check.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_name='bad'
